units.source_text: 且说冷泉帝于十月二十过后行幸六条院。

en.t: Now Emperor Reizei made an imperial visit to Rokujo-in after the twentieth day of the tenth month.

units.source_text: 此次行幸，正值红叶盛期，兴趣格外浓烈，故冷泉帝曾致书朱雀院，请其同行。

en.t: This imperial visit fell at the height of the autumn leaves, making the occasion especially delightful, so Emperor Reizei had written to Suzaku-in and asked him to come along.

units.source_text: 前皇与今上一同行幸，乃世间罕有的盛举。

en.t: For a former emperor and the reigning emperor to make an imperial visit together was a grand event rarely seen in the world.
The news stirred officials and common people throughout the country.

units.source_text: 主人源氏竭力准备迎驾，其排场之豪华令人目眩。

en.t: Genji, as the host, spared no effort in preparing to receive them, and the splendor of the arrangements was dazzling.

units.source_text: 两帝于当日巳时临幸，先到东北的马场殿。

en.t: The two emperors arrived on that day at the hour of the serpent and first went to the riding ground pavilion in the northeast.

units.source_text: 左马寮与右马寮中的马匹都已并列，左近卫与右近卫的武士也都到齐，其仪式与五月五日的骑射相似。

en.t: The horses from the Left and Right Stables were lined up, and the warriors of the Left and Right Palace Guards had all assembled; the ceremony resembled the mounted archery of the fifth day of the fifth month.

units.source_text: 未时过后移驾赴南面的正殿。

en.t: After the hour of the sheep, the imperial party moved on to the main hall on the south side.

units.source_text: 一路上的拱桥和走廊上，都铺饰锦绣。

en.t: Along the route, the arched bridges and corridors were all spread and adorned with brocades.

units.source_text: 外面望得见的地方，都张挂软幛，到处装饰十分华丽。

en.t: Every place visible from outside was hung with soft curtains, and everywhere the decorations were exceedingly splendid.

units.source_text: 道经东湖，湖中浮着几只小舟。

en.t: The route passed by the eastern lake, where several small boats were floating on the water.

units.source_text: 宫中御厨里主管鸬鹚的人，与六条院中饲鸬鹚的人，都已被召集在此，他们就在御驾经行时表演鸬鹚捕鱼。

en.t: The men in charge of cormorants in the palace kitchens and those who kept cormorants at Rokujo-in had all been summoned there, and as the imperial carriages passed, they performed cormorant fishing.

units.source_text: 鸬鹚衔了许多小鲫鱼出来。

en.t: The cormorants came up carrying many small crucian carp in their beaks.

units.source_text: 这并非为供御览而专设的游艺，只是为一路上增添兴趣而已。

en.t: This was not an entertainment specially arranged for imperial viewing, but merely something to add interest along the way.

units.source_text: 各处山上的红叶，美色各不相让。

en.t: The autumn leaves on the hills everywhere rivaled one another in beauty.

units.source_text: 但秋好皇后所居西院中的红叶特别茂盛。

en.t: But the autumn leaves in the western residence where Empress Akikonomu lived were especially luxuriant.

units.source_text: 中廊的墙壁已经拆去一部，改设大门，故观赏红叶时全无障碍。

en.t: Part of the wall of the central corridor had already been removed and replaced with a large gate, so there was no obstruction at all when viewing the autumn leaves.
